text: 队伍的不安情绪蔓延开来，你鼓舞人心的讲话也无人理会。你召集远征会议，大家决定最好造一艘木筏，顺流漂回文明世界。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 460
text: Your party’s misgivings are contagious, and your inspirational talk falls on discouraged ears. You call an expedition meeting, and it decides the best thing to do is to build a raft and drift back downriver to civilization.
